prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your adoption certificate is ready. Confirm your companion's arrival on your desktop."}}

   config: {"new_companion_emotion_preview": {"headline": "See Your Companion's Reactions", "body": "Your desktop pet responds to your daily interactions with different moods and animations.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_companion_emotion_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "Building desktop animations, behaviors, and interactive traits.", "show_progress": true}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "body": "Follow these quick tips to start interacting with your new desktop pet."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your adoption progress and desktop pet data are securely saved to your account."}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select How You Want to Adopt", "body": "Pick an instant starter companion or generate a unique custom pet from your photos."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "You can safely switch windows. We will alert you the moment your pet renders."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Favorite Companion Choice Badge: Add a recommendation badge component to highlight popular choices on the pick_friend screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Most Popular Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Quick Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on your desktop screen to access controls or hide.", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, reorder] Early Sign-In Journey Reorder: Move sign-in to the very start of onboarding before the story and choose_path steps.
   config: {"_order": ["sign_in", "story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

verdicts.reason: The redesign replaces the required official stamp with a sign-off, losing a required element of the adoption certificate's job.
Adding a new emotion preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping its core function of showing pet creation is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding an account sync security hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Updating copy while continuing to offer both preset adoption and custom pet creation complies with rule 2.
Adding notifications and time estimates to the waiting screen is allowed under onboarding customization.
Adding a recommendation badge component to the pick friend screen is allowed and fair.
Adding visual tip text to the home intro screen is allowed.
Reordering the sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted by rule 4.
